code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    cols = [j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1]
    rb, cb = [-1] + rows + [len(grid)], [-1] + cols + [len(grid[0])]
    interior = [grid[r][c] for i in range(len(rb)-1) for j in range(len(cb)-1)
                for r in range(rb[i]+1, rb[i+1]) for c in range(cb[j]+1, cb[j+1])]
    background = Counter(interior).most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker = next(color for color in set(interior) if color != background)
    return [[1 if sum(grid[r][c] == marker for r in range(rb[i]+1, rb[i+1])
                          for c in range(cb[j]+1, cb[j+1])) == 2 else background
             for j in range(len(cb)-1)] for i in range(len(rb)-1)]
'''
